verdict.rationale: The SOS site has a public Forms section, including Registered Agent forms such as Appointment of New Registered Agent and Office. It also invites visitors to 'download the notary application form now' and offers print-and-mail Annual Reports and an entity summary guide. The probe confirms the Business Center is reachable without credentials. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that business formation forms and their instructions download without an account, a direct probe of the Forms pages themselves, and independent hands-on corroboration.
